0022600131.text: The Trail Blazers (2-0, second in the Northwest and fourth in the West) visit the Lakers (3-0, first in the Pacific and first in the West) in Portland's third game of the season. Portland is missing Chris Youngblood (out, ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (out, knee surgery), and Branden Carlson (concussion) and Scoot Henderson (ankle soreness) are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The Lakers are without Adou Thiero (out, knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (out, oblique strain), and the teams have not met yet this season. Portland won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 132-116 win in Portland on January 17, 2026.
